related.title: Krafla 地熱與回注系統
related.why: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.whyEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.transfer: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.transferEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.difference: 本課針對公開儲層觀測、井筒與熱循環；Krafla 地熱與回注系統改以火山儲層、蒸汽利用與回注為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on public reservoir observations, wells and heat cycles; Krafla geothermal and reinjection system centers on volcanic resources, steam utilization and reinjection, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照EGS熱與連通與Krafla儲層觀測，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到Krafla 地熱與回注系統，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以公開microseismic目錄為起點，設計一項能區分「公開儲層觀測、井筒與熱循環」與「火山儲層、蒸汽利用與回注」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare egs heat/connectivity with krafla reservoir observations and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Krafla geothermal and reinjection system, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from public microseismic catalogs and propose an observation distinguishing public reservoir observations, wells and heat cycles from volcanic resources, steam utilization and reinjection, including uncertainty.

related.title: 增強型地熱儲層監測概念
related.transfer: 可遷移「地溫梯度與鑽井深度」與「流體回收率與補水量」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；增強型地熱儲層監測概念的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Geothermal gradient and drilling depth" and "Fluid recovery and make-up water" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Enhanced Geothermal Reservoir Monitoring Concepts must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦在沒有天然熱水的花崗岩裡造一個熱儲：斜井、循環試驗、流體回收、鑽速與微震定位；增強型地熱儲層監測概念則以監看一個人造的地下熱儲：注入體積與地震規模、示蹤試驗、熱壽命、b 值與裂隙開啟壓力為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on making a reservoir in granite with no natural hot water: a deviated well, circulation tests, fluid recovery, drilling rate and microseismic location; Enhanced Geothermal Reservoir Monitoring Concepts centres on watching an engineered reservoir underground: injected volume and magnitude, tracer tests, thermal life, b-value and fracture opening pressure, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「熱源溫度與效率上限」與「地溫梯度與鑽井深度」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「鑽速與鑽井天數」的模型移到增強型地熱儲層監測概念，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「示蹤劑與掃掠體積」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling" and "Geothermal gradient and drilling depth".
Move the model of "Drilling rate and days on the well" to Enhanced Geothermal Reservoir Monitoring Concepts, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Tracers and swept volume", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「地溫梯度與鑽井深度」與「流體回收率與補水量」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；增強型地熱儲層監測概念的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Geothermal gradient and drilling depth" and "Fluid recovery and make-up water" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Enhanced Geothermal Reservoir Monitoring Concepts must be respecified.

related.title: 雙循環地熱發電系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「地溫梯度與鑽井深度」與「流體回收率與補水量」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；雙循環地熱發電系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Geothermal gradient and drilling depth" and "Fluid recovery and make-up water" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Binary Cycle Geothermal Power Systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦在沒有天然熱水的花崗岩裡造一個熱儲：斜井、循環試驗、流體回收、鑽速與微震定位；雙循環地熱發電系統則以用七十幾度的溫水發電：冷源的重要、工質壓力比、工質流量、泵功與取代的柴油為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on making a reservoir in granite with no natural hot water: a deviated well, circulation tests, fluid recovery, drilling rate and microseismic location; Binary Cycle Geothermal Power Systems centres on generating from water at seventy-odd degrees: the cold sink, working-fluid pressure ratio, fluid flow, pump work and diesel displaced, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「熱源溫度與效率上限」與「熱源溫度與效率上限」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「鑽速與鑽井天數」的模型移到雙循環地熱發電系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「工質泵的耗功」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling" and "Source temperature and the efficiency ceiling".
Move the model of "Drilling rate and days on the well" to Binary Cycle Geothermal Power Systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Work of the feed pump", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「地溫梯度與鑽井深度」與「流體回收率與補水量」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；雙循環地熱發電系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Geothermal gradient and drilling depth" and "Fluid recovery and make-up water" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Binary Cycle Geothermal Power Systems must be respecified.
